attributes.background:
I would like a General Election.
I have No confidence in the Labour Government.
The manifesto, promised so much when I voted for Labour.
They appear to have forgotten what they were voted in for.
I & millions of people voted for Sir keir Starmer to lead our country for the next 5 years.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771833
